text: For every odd prime p: 2 is a square in Q_p exactly when p = 1 or 7 mod 8.
argument: 2 is a unit at an odd p, so it is a square in Q_p exactly when it is a square mod p
(Conrad, Example 2.9); 2 is a square mod p exactly when p = 1 or 7 mod 8 (Shoup, Theorem
12.1 (iv), recast after it). This covers the odd primes below the stop line too.
